mentions.name: LanguageOps
mentions.description: A translation SaaS that matches what $50k+ incumbents offer while adding automated QA and LQA, A/V work, and smart LLM translation paired with millisecond translation memory and termbase matching for often multi-gigabyte memory and termbase files. It handles files with millions of words, intelligently propagates similar segments, uses tokens only where required, and stays compatible with all major translation tools, with human-in-the-loop workflows proven with high-volume translation clients.
mentions.problem: Incumbent translation platforms are expensive and lack automated QA, while LLM translations still need human oversight and correction, including squashing LLM-ese to retain voice and meaning.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've had the opportunity to spend the last 12 months working on a translation SaaS that does everything the $50k+ incumbents do but also automated QA and LQA, A/V work, smart LLM translation vs millisecond TM and TB matching (memory and termbase files, often gb in size).
mentions.author: luxpir
